card.name: Subject noun before a news verb
card.fires_on: The last word of a named organization, place or institution that is the subject of a news headline, right where a verb is expected next. Examples are University, Office, Union, FCC and Guinea in web headline lists.

modes.label: Organization name ends
modes.description: Final word of an institution or agency name in a headline list, before its verb.
modes.example: - Oakland County Sheriff’s<< Office>> veteran — Michigan's first black police captain

modes.label: Company or place as subject
modes.description: Last piece of a company or place name acting as the subject of a headline.

modes.label: Dated headline agency
modes.description: Agency or body named right after a date, before its action verb.
modes.example: 04-14-2011:<< FCC>> Adopts Equipment Program for Persons with Disabilities

card.writes: It favors verbs of getting ready or speeding up, such as preparing, enters, gears, and their Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It fires on the end of a name that is the subject of a news headline, just before the action verb.
